nom: Hero Cosmetics Bright Eyes Illuminating Eye Cream

avis.texte: Literally does nothing to your eyes, bags, dark circles, etc. please don't waste your money.

This is my first time ever writing a review on ulta and I've been a customer of Ulta since I could remember. I don't really like writing reviews but this product not adequate. I have tried it for almost a month now everyday trying to figure out a way to stop it from peeling on my skin once i add makeup or even sunscreen but it peels no matter what.
I've been trying this for honestly over a couple months my bags look the same you're still the same color
just like everyone else said. Kept in cool, dry place and the applicator grows mold. NOT worth it. Just good packaging.
Don't buy this. It literally does not work and is just an attractive packaging. READ THE INGREDIENTS
Bought this twice and both times it grew mold in the applicator. I keep it in a dry, clean place with the lid on it. No reason that should've happened.
the applicator grew mold on it after 2 uses andni kept it is a clean and dry environment. the formula also isn't special. not worth it.
the applicator grew mold on it after only less than a week use. I kept is in a clean and dry environment so idk why it did that. the formula also isn't special. it actually dried out my skin.
I did try this once and niw im obsessed, idk why all the negative reviews everyone us different but for me it works, it goes smooth and once you distribute the product it leaves a nice glow…
This is one of my favorite eye creams for brightening my under eyes with a subtle tint. It lasts all day with no weird creasing or flaking. Definitely recommend this to anyone!

I noticed after using this cream for quite some time that it dries with a white residue left over. And then it just looks like I put on under eye concealer that was not my shade at all. Not a fan. Do not recommended for anyone to be honest.
I got this for my daughter because she has darker shadows under her eyes. I noticed a difference and she loves it. She has sensitive skin and caused no reactions.
Applicator is great but i do not see a difference sometimes i put alot under my eye just to sleep with overnight buy i dont see any brightening
I didn't see or feel anything special, kinda drying and no brightening .

I cant say enough good things about this. This goes on really smooth and the applicator is really nice. It is a little messy but this stuff dries so fast and blends out really easily. I have oily skin and it also is very brightening.
